The [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic SpecForce]] defector [[Bex Kolos]], better known as Gearbox, developed the walker codenamed [[Project B]] in a '''bunker''' in the [[Glarus Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[SpecForce Incident]], [[Havoc Squad]] used information from [[Markus Andarius Thul|Markus Thul]] to track down Gearbox at the bunker, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him after defeating the walker.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gearbox's bunker appears in the Trooper class mission "The Future of War" on Alderaan in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
